newsitem.title: USA: Israeli envoy to present credentials to Clinton.
newsitem.headline: Israeli envoy to present credentials to Clinton.

text.p: Israel's new ambassador to the United States, Eliahu Ben-Elissar, will present his credentials to President Bill Clinton at the White House Wednesday, the Israeli embassay said on Tuesday.
Ben-Elissar replaced Itimar Rabinovich, who resigned after Likud leader Benjamin Netanyahu ousted former Prime Minister Shimon Peres in last May's elections.
Ben-Elissar on Thursday will lay wreaths at both the U.S. Holocaust Museum and the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at Arlington National Cemetery when he visits the two sites, the embassy said.
